title: VSp 2 sweet potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: VSp 2 sweet potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: VSp 2 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. 100 to 135 days to harvest, 19 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: VSp 2 is a registered sweet potato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1983. It takes 100 to 135 days from planting to harvest, with 19 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 100 to 135 days from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 19 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about VSp 2 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

VSp 2 sweet potato takes 100 to 135 days from planting to harvest. That is 3 days longer than the average of the 26 sweet potato varieties with a day count, 114.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 19 t/ha beats the average of its group, 15.15. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Dry matter is 33 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 27 percent.
Where and when to plant VSp 2 sweet potato
Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 100 to 135 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 19 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of VSp 2?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
